text: According to the applicants, at 3 p.m. on 24 November 2007, at the end of the gathering on Academician Sakharov Prospekt, the applicants started walking to the location of another authorised gathering on Chistoprudnyy Boulevard.

text: The Government alleged that some 1,500 people took part in the procession on 24 November 2007.

text: The applicants contested the Government's figure of 1,500 participants in the procession as grossly overestimated.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On their way from Academician Sakharov Prospekt, which ran past Myasnitskaya Street, the applicants also intended to take a petition to the Central Electoral Committee.
